rows.headline: Trump Says Iran Talks to Begin Monday After Scrapping Attack
rows.covered_closest_by: Bloomberg; Reuters; Wall Street Journal; New York Times
rows.also_carried_by: Al Jazeera; Associated Press; BBC; CBC; CNBC; Globe and Mail
rows.snippet: President Trump said talks with Iran will begin Monday after he called off a planned U.S. Attack on the country. Reports on the status of negotiations conflicted, with Trump announcing the talks while Iran said no talks with the United States were under way. Oil prices fell following Trump's announcement of the planned talks and the halt in fighting.

rows.headline: Trump’s attorney general pick says he has reached deal with senators after standoff – US politics live
rows.covered_closest_by: Guardian; Reuters; Wall Street Journal; Bloomberg
rows.snippet: Acting U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche issued a formal order late Sunday terminating President Trump's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization fund" ahead of a vote on his nomination as attorney general. The move followed weeks of negotiations with Republican senators who had been blocking his nomination, and Blanche said he has reached a deal with the senators.

rows.headline: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi meets Red Cross official
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; BBC; Guardian
rows.snippet: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi met with an official from the International Committee of the Red Cross, the organization confirmed. Photos released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi at the meeting, her first confirmed outside contact in two and a half years. Suu Kyi was ousted in a 2021 coup, and the meeting followed years of questions about her wellbeing.

rows.headline: About 60,000 ordered to evacuate from fires in Spokane, Washington
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; BBC; Guardian
rows.snippet: Wildfires in and around Spokane, Washington, have forced the evacuation of about 60,000 people, authorities said Sunday. The fires in eastern Washington have destroyed at least 600 homes, businesses and other structures. Officials said the blazes have stretched the ability of federal and local agencies to fight them.

rows.headline: US Senator Moreno says Ohio's Miller should not serve in Congress, citing abuse allegations
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; New York Times; Associated Press; CNBC
rows.snippet: U.S. Senator Bernie Moreno, Republican of Ohio, said Representative Max Miller, his former son-in-law, should not serve in Congress, citing allegations of domestic abuse made by Moreno's daughter, Emily Moreno, Miller's ex-wife. Moreno also said Miller needs psychological help. Miller has denied the allegations.

rows.headline: AstraZeneca investors balk at $400 billion Bristol Myers tie-up reports
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Bloomberg; Financial Times; Wall Street Journal
rows.snippet: AstraZeneca has held talks with Bristol Myers Squibb over a potential $400 billion tie-up, according to reports citing a source. Following the reports, AstraZeneca shares fell while Bristol Myers Squibb shares rose.

rows.headline: ‘Is there a Jays game?’: Passengers scrambling after WestJet flight attendants strike
rows.covered_closest_by: CTV News; Reuters; New York Times; Globe and Mail
rows.snippet: WestJet flight attendants went on strike after contract talks fell through, prompting the Canadian airline to cancel flights and leaving passengers scrambling. The union representing 4,400 flight attendants is seeking improved wages and compensation for unpaid work. Labor talks between the airline and the union resumed on Sunday.

rows.headline: Israel says it has serious concerns with Hamas disarmament deal
rows.covered_closest_by: Associated Press; Politico; BBC; NPR
rows.snippet: Israel said it has serious concerns with a proposed Hamas disarmament deal announced by President Trump last week. Israeli strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah overnight and into Sunday evening killed at least 17 people, including children. Israel said the strikes targeted military operatives.

rows.headline: Kay Granger, first Republican woman to lead House Appropriations Committee, dies at 83
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; Washington Post; Politico
rows.snippet: Kay Granger, the first Republican woman from Texas to serve in the U.S. House of Representatives, has died at age 83. She spent 28 years in Congress and was the first Republican woman to lead the House Appropriations Committee. Before entering Congress, Granger served as the first female mayor of Fort Worth.

rows.headline: Five dead, 41 missing after Indonesian ferry catches fire, authorities say
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; CBC; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: A ferry caught fire in waters off Indonesia's main island of Java on Sunday, leaving at least five people dead, authorities said. Rescuers pulled 229 people from the vessel and continued searching Monday for possible missing passengers. The number of people missing remained unclear, with one report putting it at 41 and rescuers elsewhere saying the figure was unknown.

rows.headline: Ohio Rep. Kaptur treated for non-life threatening injuries after a car accident in Toledo
rows.covered_closest_by: Associated Press; Politico; Guardian; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: U.S. Rep. Marcy Kaptur, an Ohio Democrat, was hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries after a two-vehicle hit-and-run collision in Toledo, Ohio, on Sunday, her office said. Kaptur, 80, was a passenger in the vehicle and on her way to church at the time of the crash. Toledo police said she was active and alert.

rows.headline: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' opens to a huge $927 million global box office
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; New York Times; Associated Press; CNBC
rows.snippet: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" opened with an estimated $355 million at the North American box office, the second-highest domestic debut ever, behind "Avengers: Endgame." Estimates of the film's global opening ranged from $875 million to $927 million. The Sony Pictures and Marvel release is the 11th big-budget Spider-Man film since 2002.

rows.headline: English FA set to withdraw support for Fifa president Infantino
rows.covered_closest_by: BBC; Reuters; Al Jazeera
rows.snippet: The English Football Association is set to withdraw its support for Gianni Infantino's bid to continue as Fifa president, following a similar move by Wales. The FA is expected to write to Infantino to formally withdraw its backing for his re-election. The move comes amid fallout from Infantino's scrapped plans to sell stakes in Fifa competitions to private investors.

rows.headline: 2 firefighting helicopters collide midair near Athens as Europe’s wildfire emergency rages
rows.covered_closest_by: CTV News; New York Times; Associated Press
rows.snippet: Two people were killed when two firefighting helicopters collided midair near Athens. The aircraft crashed while battling a wildfire northwest of the city. Greece has fought more than 200 fires in the past week amid a wildfire emergency in Europe.

rows.headline: Dodgers land Cy Young ace Tarik Skubal in a blockbuster deadline deal
rows.covered_closest_by: Globe and Mail; Associated Press; Guardian
rows.snippet: The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired pitcher Tarik Skubal from the Detroit Tigers on Saturday night in a trade deadline deal, sending prospects to Detroit in return. Skubal is the two-time reigning American League Cy Young Award winner. The Dodgers are the defending champions.

rows.headline: Asian stocks are mixed as yen jumps against the dollar, while oil prices slip
rows.covered_closest_by: Globe and Mail; Associated Press; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: World stock markets were mixed as the Japanese yen jumped against the U.S. Oil prices slipped during the same session.

rows.headline: Ariana Grande stepping back from appearances after public scrutiny
rows.covered_closest_by: CTV News; Associated Press; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: Ariana Grande has withdrawn from a London musical and said she will step back from public appearances. The singer plans to take a break from the public eye following public scrutiny.

rows.headline: WestJet flight attendants to end strike after reaching tentative wage deal
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; New York Times; CTV News
rows.snippet: WestJet and the union representing its flight attendants reached a tentative wage deal early Monday to end a strike. The walkout began a day earlier, when 4,400 flight attendants left their jobs, resulting in the cancellation of hundreds of flights. The agreement will end the strike across the country.

rows.headline: Ukrainian drones kill eight in Russia and strike Wildberries warehouse, governors say
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: Ukrainian drone strikes in Russia killed multiple people, with reports of the death toll ranging from five to eight, according to regional governors. The drones also struck a Wildberries warehouse, setting it on fire.

rows.headline: Blanche Gives G.O.P. Senators Written Assurances on Trump’s I.R.S. Deal
rows.covered_closest_by: New York Times; Associated Press; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: Todd Blanche rescinded a planned $1.8 billion fund for allies of President Trump after Republican senators threatened to block his confirmation as attorney general. Blanche also provided GOP senators with written assurances regarding the deal, which had held up his confirmation over concerns about the fund and the president's immunity from tax scrutiny.

rows.headline: New ‘Spider-Man’ Movie Scores Hollywood’s Second-Biggest Debut Ever
rows.covered_closest_by: Wall Street Journal; Bloomberg; BBC
rows.snippet: The new Spider-Man movie recorded the second-biggest debut in Hollywood history during its global opening weekend. The box office performance gives a boost to Disney ahead of the release of Avengers: Doomsday.

rows.headline: Massive Attack band says Singapore police detained, questioned them after concert
rows.covered_closest_by: Reuters; Associated Press; BBC
rows.snippet: Singapore has banned two members of the British band Massive Attack following a pro-Palestine display at a concert in the country. The band said Singapore police detained and questioned them after the show, during which "free Palestine" was shouted. The band said it was "surprised and disappointed" by its treatment.

rows.headline: European soccer body UEFA warns FIFA of legal action over Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan
rows.covered_closest_by: Associated Press; Financial Times; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: European soccer governing body UEFA has warned FIFA that it may pursue legal action over FIFA President Gianni Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan. The dispute concerns a commercialization effort at FIFA that did not go forward. UEFA's warning puts the two soccer bodies in a potential legal conflict over the matter.

rows.headline: Rallies surround Fever-Lynx game after Sophie Cunningham's stance on transgender athletes
rows.covered_closest_by: Associated Press; Globe and Mail; Toronto Star
rows.snippet: Rallies took place surrounding a game between the Indiana Fever and Minnesota Lynx. The demonstrations followed Sophie Cunningham sharing her stance on transgender athletes.

profiles.name: local
profiles.why: Zero metered spend. All five stages on llama-swap. Slowest wall-clock.

profiles.name: fast-snippets
profiles.why: Snippet prose on Claude, everything else local. Snippet_writing is the only stage whose output is read verbatim, and local scored 100% on the malformedness gate only -- so this buys prose quality, not correctness.

profiles.name: safe-verify
profiles.why: Entailment on Claude, everything else local. Buys back the ONE residual gap: v4flash has effective recall 6/7 = 86% (95% CI 50-98%) with zero false alarms on 15 supported controls, because a missing verdict routes to repair rather than publishing. The remaining miss (case4) is a fabrication both local models called supported. Use when a run's output must not carry a fabricated claim stamped verified.

profiles.name: fast
profiles.why: The pre-fully-local routing. Cheap high-volume stages stay local; the two stages where a local miss is visible in the output go to Claude.

profiles.name: claude
profiles.why: Everything metered. Fastest wall-clock, full cost. Escape hatch if llama-swap is down.
